contract.description: Add a Zod schema + inferred types for a resource to @menu/shared/contracts.

feature-lib.description: Create a routed Angular feature lib (libs/web/<domain>/feature-<name>) and register its lazy route.

data-access-lib.description: Add a Signal Store + validated API client for a resource to libs/web/<domain>/data-access.

nest-resource.description: Add a Nest module/controller/service, Prisma repository + model, and specs for a resource.

domain.description: Register a domain scope tag, optionally scaffolding its first resource end to end.

adr.description: Create a numbered architecture decision record in docs/decisions.

util-lib.description: Create a util lib (libs/<platform>/<domain>/util[-<name>]) for pure helpers and value types.
